notes: Standing check brackets the result: 961 standing still, 1043 at speed. Training reward settled at ~1010, between the two, consistent with a policy that mostly holds pose and creeps. Confirms the prediction in episodes/001-hound-throughput.md that reward was not the bottleneck. Video not yet reviewed.

First PD position-target run. Reached eval>=1100 at 300,809 steps vs the torque run's 1,502,322 — 5x fewer samples for the same band. Mean eval after 400k: 1113.1 vs torque's 887.5, i.e. far more stable; torque kept collapsing to 390-955 throughout 3.75M. Peak eval slightly LOWER than torque (1176.7 vs 1218.3), so PD lowered the cost of reaching the plateau without raising the ceiling. ep_rew_mean was still at its maximum when the run ended, so 1M steps did not converge. Episode 002's 55% call (clear 1096) hit at 1099.63, by 3.6 points.

Second training seed on the PD arm — the first time any arm in this record has more than one. Seed is the ONLY changed variable (same env, same 1,000,000 steps, same hyperparameters as hound_pd_desert_v0). Reached the same band, not a better one: final_ep_rew_mean 1052.31 vs seed 0's 1099.63, so 'plateau' is against the ARM's known ceiling, not against its own curve — like seed 0, ep_rew_mean had not converged at 1M. Harvested with greedy_eval at n=60 on seeds 0-59: 1140.65 +/- 161.41, 2 crashes (3.3%), against a zero-action control of 955.58 +/- 0.68 on the same seeds = ratio x1.194. Seed 0 RE-MEASURED under that identical protocol on the same day gives 1049.10 +/- 324.36 with 8 crashes = x1.098, so the honest two-seed spread is 91.55 return points. Do NOT compare against episode 004's published 1078.2 for seed 0: that used three different seed blocks, and the 29-point gap between the two readings of the SAME checkpoint is well inside the n=60 standard error of +/-41.8 that seed 0's own spread implies. Both readings are reproducible — repeated runs of greedy_eval returned byte-identical means. The mean on this arm is largely a crash-rate proxy: 58/60 episodes sit at ~1170 and the crashes at 191-376, so 6 crashes of difference moves the mean ~90 points.
